jobs.name: Oni
jobs.detail: Image1 is character identity reference. ONI: obsidian jagged armored robot, horned sealed helmet, orange slit eyes, violet armor highlights, tattered navy tabard, twin curved cyan-white-violet-magenta energy blades. Keep BOTH blades. Head flame must flicker and curl in distinctly different shapes in the FOUR idle frames, while armor breathes subtly. Move flames on blades too. Light: alternating blade slashes. Heavy: two-blade cross slash. Special: wide twin-blade energy burst. No human face.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art fighting-game animation atlas.
Create ONE precisely arranged sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR columns and SIX rows (24 equal rectangular cells). Every cell contains one COMPLETE full-body sprite of the SAME character, consistently facing RIGHT in 3/4 side view. No text, labels, dividers, background, shadows on ground, contact sheets, portraits or additional characters. Genuine transparent alpha. Wide transparent gutters between all sprites, no touching cells or cropped weapons. Same body size across all poses, same visual style as reference: chibi 2.5-head-tall retro fantasy fighter, crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines, limited stepped cel shading, no blur. Body centered in each cell, consistent foot baseline. Leave room for weapons and wings without shrinking body between cells.
EXACT cell ordering left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1: four sequential idle breathing frames A/B/C/D, subtle changes to shoulders, hair/cloth, and glowing elements; a seamless loop, feet share baseline.
ROW 2: four sequential movement cycle frames A/B/C/D. Alternating legs and arms with weight shift, or wing-powered glide for flying characters.
ROW 3: guard/block pose; airborne jump pose; low crouch pose; hurt recoil pose.
ROW 4: LIGHT ATTACK four frames: windup; first active strike; follow-through active strike; recovery toward ready stance.
ROW 5: HEAVY ATTACK four frames: exaggerated anticipation; powerful active blow; extended follow-through; recovery.
ROW 6: special move anticipation; special active; special follow-through; fallen horizontal knockdown.
Combat poses must visibly change arms, legs, torso and weapons, not merely recolor or translate the idle sprite. Readable clean silhouettes and anatomy at small in-game scale. Keep face, outfit, colors and equipment identifiable from references across all24 cells.

jobs.name: Angelix
jobs.detail: Image1 character identity. ANGELIX: adult female chibi winged mage, long blonde hair, cyan eyes, silver/navy jeweled crown and armor, dark flowing cape, large cyan feather wings, huge crescent-ring darkmetal staff containing glowing cyan orbital sphere. NO PET OR BIRD. She hovers with bent dangling feet; idle wings gently flap and hair/cape sway across four frames. Movement is aerial glide with changing wing positions, no walking feet. Light attack: staff swipe. Heavy: broad staff arc. Special: aims staff and releases cyan orb. Guard with staff raised, wings folding. Keep staff and wings in all cells.

jobs.name: Phoenix
jobs.detail: Image1 character identity; Image2 REQUIRED replacement weapon. PHOENIX: adult female chibi red-haired valkyrie, purple/navy/silver armor, gold horned tiara, huge gold mechanical feather wings, purple/gold kite shield. REPLACE old slim sword with exact Image2 oversized GOLDEN GEOMETRIC GREATSWORD: wide glowing rectangular gold energy blade with square circuit patterns and black/bronze angular frame, square gem guard. SWORD LENGTH 1.35 TIMES HER BODY HEIGHT, clearly larger than her entire body in every upright pose. She floats with feet dangling. Idle wings flap, red hair sways, sword energy shimmers. Movement gliding flight. Light: forward greatsword cut; heavy: overhead greatsword cleave; special: golden sword shockwave. Keep shield, wings and required oversized geometric sword consistent, do NOT turn sword into slim rapier.

jobs.name: PO
jobs.detail: Image1 character identity; Image2 katana reference. PO: round plump panda samurai ninja, black/white fur, green eyes, wide dark conical hat with gold engraving and red tassels, cream/dark Japanese robes, green scarf and sash, black bracers. Keep round belly and short sturdy limbs. Equip a STRAIGHT pale-jade katana with silver edge and black/cyan diamond-wrapped hilt from Image2; scabbard at waist. Idle katana held ready, tassels/scarf flutter, belly breathes. Walk cycle waddling with determined poise. Light: swift katana draw slash; heavy: two-handed overhead cut; special: spinning samurai cut with green arc. No staff or unrelated weapon. Hat stays on.

jobs.name: Golem
jobs.detail: Image1 character identity; Image2 weapon shape. GOLEM: broad bulky mossy grey boulder elemental, olive moss, cyan crystal spikes on shoulders/back, bright cyan spiral core, green slit eyes, dangling brown roots and tiny purple fronds. jobs.name: Glacier
jobs.detail: Image1 character identity with requested adjustment. GLACIER: broad muscular crystalline ICE GOLEM, icy pale-blue body, huge cyan crystal crown/shoulder/forearm spikes, bright cyan eyes, dark navy knuckles. BARE FIST FIGHTER, NO WEAPONS.
